[2026-07-24] MAINTAINER-AUTHORISED one-line fix to YOUR file client/src/scenes/WorldScene.ts (root cause of a reported ambient-water bug): isWaterAtScreen was TOP-ONLY (cell.l === l), so a lake BEHIND a cliff resolved as 'water' all the way down the cliff FACE — my water-glimmer FX (and your snow-melt, same probe) drew THROUGH the wall. Made it FACE-AWARE: scanning level high→low already walks candidate cells strictly front-to-back (v=col+row grows with l), and a cell stacks face tiles for levels 0..cell.l then its top, so its drawn column covers the point whenever cell.l >= l (top OR face). Changed the reject test from 'cell.l !== l' to 'cell.l < l' — now it returns the FRONT-MOST drawn surface, stopping on the occluding cliff face instead of the lake behind it. Also fixes snow melting through walls. No behaviour change on open water (front-most cell there IS the lake). Verified on the_island2 at (165,42) via __ml.teleport: the cliff face resolves to the level-32 ice cell at every depth (land, no water), the visible lake beside it resolves to clear_water; glimmer now lands only on real water. typecheck green. Happy to hand the block over or adjust if you'd rather own it — ping if you reshape isWaterAtScreen/waterAtScreen.
